newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Hong Kong gold ends down on overseas sales.
newsitem.headline: Hong Kong gold ends down on overseas sales.

text.p: Hong Kong spot gold ended down on Tuesday compared to New York's previous close after a day of consistent selling interest from overseas punters, bullion traders said.
Bullion closed at US$343.90/344.40 per ounce on Tuesday from the previous New York close at US$344.00/50.
Dealers reported selling interest from Japan on currency movements as well as sales from British and Swiss customers later in the day.
A slight drop in platinum borrowing meant gold softened slightly, some dealers said.
Physical gold demand was average, with Hong Kong kilobar premiums softening this week to around 65 cents over the spot London price, compared to levels around 160 cents around March.
Local tael gold ended HK$22 higher at HK$3,183.
The carry over charge at the Chinese Gold and Silver Exchange Society rose to +4.00 from its previous fix at -5.00.
